title: Sparse Render Measurement
description: What each component renders when the caller supplies NO props, measured two ways. bySlug counts the elements carrying visible text in a render with an empty prop bag, which catches a fallback that adds a NEW text-bearing element. inventedSlots names the (slug, prop) pairs where supplying the prop REMOVES content from the markup, which catches the three shapes the count cannot see: a fallback injected into an element that already carries text, one carried by an attribute, and one inside an svg. Emitted by scripts/render/derive-sparse-render.js into components/render/dist/sparse-render.json and read by tests/render/sparse-render-ratchet.test.js, which fails when a count rises or the set grows against this artifact as it stood at the merge base. The property protected is that a component must not invent content the caller did not ask for: a literal fallback in the renderer removes the caller's ability to render the component without it, which is what shipped in #543 and was only partly undone in #544. Neither measure is a target to drive to zero; plenty of sparse text is structural chrome and plenty of props have a designed fallback, so only the direction is a defect.

_meta.description: Provenance stamp carried by every generated JSON in this repo, so a reader can tell derived content from authored content.

examples.do_not_edit: Regenerate with `npm run derive:render`. Hand edits are overwritten.

auto_generated.description: Always true: this file is regenerated by CI and hand edits do not survive.

source.description: What was measured, so a moved number can be traced to the file that moved.

do_not_edit.description: The command that regenerates this file, printed where an editor will see it.
examples: Regenerate with `npm run derive:render`. Hand edits are overwritten.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this envelope shape, bumped when the structure changes so a vendored consumer can detect a shape it cannot read.

generatedBy.description: Repo-relative path of the derive script that produced this measurement, for provenance.

totals.description: The repo-wide headline, so a reader learns the direction of the whole tier without summing bySlug or counting inventedSlots, plus the scope figures that say how much of the surface these measurements actually reach.

slugs.description: How many components were measured. Equal to the render contract's slug count, since the slug list is read from it.

slugsWithText.description: How many of those render any visible text at all with no props supplied. Reported for orientation, never gated: a component whose entire content is structural chrome legitimately belongs here.

textBearingElements.description: The sum of bySlug. This is the headline the ratchet gates in addition to the per-slug counts, so a rise cannot hide behind a fall somewhere else.

inventedSlots.description: The size of the inventedSlots list: how many (slug, prop) pairs currently displace content the renderer invented for them. Reported for direction; the ratchet blocks on the membership of the list itself, so a pair added while another is removed still fails.

pairsInContract.description: How many (slug, prop) pairs the render contract lists in total. The gap against pairsProbed is the first scope limit, published rather than described: a prop whose value never reaches the markup is skipped by the pair check, so a fallback behind such a prop is not measured.

pairsProbed.description: How many of those pairs the sentinel actually reached, and therefore how many were checked for displaced content. Props the contract cannot see at all (a computed read such as props["Sc" + "ope"]) are in neither figure, which is the second scope limit.

cellsRendered.description: How many variant-matrix cells were rendered: one per slug, with no variant and no props. Both measurements are sparse by design, so this is always the slug count.

matrixCells.description: How many cells the variant matrix has in total. The gap against cellsRendered is the third scope limit: a fallback reachable only under a non-default variant or State (a literal in a Welcome branch, or in an expanded accordion) is never executed by these measurements and cannot move either number.

bySlug.description: One entry per render slug, keyed by slug: the number of elements carrying visible text when that component is rendered with an empty prop bag and no variant. Elements rather than characters or text runs, so rewording copy does not move the number and a new part always does. Attribute values (placeholder, aria-label) and the contents of svg/script/style are not counted.

additionalProperties.description: Text-bearing elements this component renders with no props supplied. Zero means it renders nothing a reader could read without being given content, which is the ideal for a component with no structural copy of its own.

inventedSlots.description: Every "<slug>.<prop>" pair for which supplying the prop REMOVES content from the markup, sorted. Measured by rendering the slug empty and again with a sentinel in that prop, then checking that the empty render survives inside the sentinel render with the sentinel taken out: supplying a prop may add markup, never take it away. A member is a prop with a fallback of some kind, which is often the design and sometimes the defect; what the ratchet blocks is a NEW member. Props whose value never reaches the markup (booleans, enums the renderer only compares against) are not measured, since their renders differ for reasons unrelated to invented content.

items.description: One pair, written "<slug>.<prop>". The prop name is the renderer's own spelling and may contain spaces, e.g. "search.Placeholder text".
